claims.excerpt: De James Webb-ruimtetelescoop moest opgevouwen in de kuip van de Ariane 5 passen.
claims.claim: Webb was designed to be folded so it would fit inside the Ariane 5 fairing.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Webb was designed to fold into a compact launch configuration that fit inside the Ariane 5.
claims.narrative: Webb moest compact in de Ariane 5-raket passen
claims.explanation: The source confirms the folded launch configuration was designed to fit inside the Ariane 5 fairing.
claims.materiality: Provides accurate context for why Webb had to unfold after launch.

claims.excerpt: In zijn operationele configuratie was hij daarvoor te groot.
claims.claim: Webb was too large to fit in the Ariane 5 fairing in its operational configuration.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Webb's fully deployed operational configuration is far too large to fit into any available rocket so it was designed to fold into a compact launch configuration that fit inside the Ariane 5.
claims.narrative: hoewel zijn operationele configuratie daarvoor te groot was
claims.explanation: The source explicitly says the fully deployed configuration was too large for any available rocket.
claims.materiality: Establishes the design constraint behind the folding and deployment.

claims.excerpt: De uitvouwing bestond uit veel stappen, met mogelijke faalpunten.
claims.claim: Webb's deployment involved many steps and possible single points of failure.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: There were over 50 major deployment steps, with 178 release mechanisms that had to perform perfectly or any one of over 300 single points of failure could have diminished or crippled the mission.
claims.narrative: De uitvouwing omvatte veel stappen en mogelijke faalpunten
claims.explanation: The source describes more than 50 major steps and over 300 possible single points of failure; the piece does not imply that any failure occurred.
claims.materiality: Conveys the complexity and stakes of deployment without alleging a mishap.

claims.excerpt: In de tweede week waren de spiegels uitgevouwen en vergrendeld
claims.claim: By the second week, Webb's mirror structures had unfolded and latched into place.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: During the second week after launch, we finished deploying the telescope structures by unfolding and latching the secondary mirror tripod and rotating and latching the two primary mirror wings.
claims.narrative: In de tweede week waren de spiegels uitgevouwen en vergrendeld
claims.explanation: The source reports that the secondary mirror tripod and both primary mirror wings were unfolded and latched during the second week.
claims.materiality: A key milestone in the deployment timeline.

claims.excerpt: en had Webb zijn operationele configuratie bereikt.
claims.claim: Webb reached its fully deployed operational configuration in the second week.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: During the second week after launch, we finished deploying the telescope structures ... This brought Webb into its fully deployed operational configuration.
claims.narrative: had Webb zijn operationele configuratie bereikt
claims.explanation: The source directly places completion of Webb's fully deployed operational configuration in the second week.
claims.materiality: Distinguishes completion of deployment from later commissioning.

claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Webb's deployment was completed with remarkable smoothness.
claims.explanation: The source describes the deployment as remarkably smooth.
claims.materiality: Rules out an implication that later commissioning was recovery from a deployment failure.

claims.excerpt: Maar uitgevouwen betekende nog niet klaar voor routinewetenschap.
claims.claim: Reaching the deployed configuration did not mean Webb was ready for routine science.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: The remaining five months of commissioning were all about aligning the optics and calibrating the scientific instruments. ... After six months: “Science operations!” Webb began its science mission and started to conduct routine science operations.
claims.narrative: maar was niet hetzelfde als klaar zijn voor routinewetenschap
claims.explanation: The source places alignment and instrument calibration after deployment, with routine science beginning after six months.
claims.materiality: This is the central distinction made by the piece.

claims.excerpt: Tijdens de ingebruikname volgden weken van afkoeling, maanden van spiegeluitlijning en daarna de kalibratie van de instrumenten.
claims.claim: During commissioning, Webb underwent several weeks of cooling, months of mirror alignment, and then instrument calibration.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: In the first month ... it took several weeks for them to cool all the way down and reach stable temperatures. ... In the second, third and fourth months: Initial optics checkouts, and telescope alignment. ... In the fifth and sixth months: Calibration and completion of commissioning.

claims.explanation: The source gives this sequence and timing: several weeks of cooling, alignment in months two through four, and calibration in months five and six.

claims.excerpt: Na zes maanden begon Webb aan routinewetenschap.
claims.claim: Webb began routine science operations after six months.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: After six months: “Science operations!” Webb began its science mission and started to conduct routine science operations.
claims.narrative: Na zes maanden begon Webb aan routinewetenschap
claims.explanation: The source states that routine science operations began after six months.
claims.materiality: Provides the endpoint of the commissioning timeline.

claims.claim: Deployment was an important milestone, but not the end of commissioning.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: During the second week after launch ... This brought Webb into its fully deployed operational configuration. ... The remaining five months of commissioning were all about aligning the optics and calibrating the scientific instruments.
